title: security: rbac v2 - KMS residency + region-pinning audit hardening
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Harden RBAC v2 KMS residency enforcement and audit logging: new residency validation, additional audit events for KMS usage, tighter admin policy checks. No customer-facing API changes; configuration flags added for private deployments.
description:
Motivation: We've seen multiple customer requests and internal audits calling out gaps in enforcement and observability for KMS region residency and RBAC v2 policies. This PR hardens policy checks and expands audit logging so that region-pinning violations and KMS key residency decisions are recorded and actionable.

Summary of changes: - Add KMS residency validation layer in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator (residency_check.go + tests). The validator runs at policy evaluation and at key-binding time to enforce region pinning for resources bound to a project/namespace. - Emit structured audit events for KMS operations: kms.key.bind_attempt, kms.key.bind_success, kms.key.bind_denied, kms.key.rotated, kms.key.residency_violation_detected. Events include user, resource, requested_region, effective_region, policy_id, and request_id. - Add an optional enforcement mode flag (rbac.kms.residency.enforce=false by default) and a roll-forward guide in docs. Default remains audit-only for staged rollout. - Integrate residency checks into the private installer so on-prem deployments get consistent validation at install/upgrade time. - Add Linear/SEC links and unit/integration tests covering both positive and negative residency scenarios.

Commits: - 8f4b2d2: Add residency validator and unit tests - 2c1a7b9: Emit structured audit events for KMS binding lifecycle - 9b7f4e1: Config flag and feature toggle for enforcement - d5a6c3f: Private installer integration and upgrade checks - e1b2c3a: Docs: rollout guide and upgrade notes - 4c8d9f0: Fix race in policy cache observed in integration tests

Files changed (high level): - rbac/policy/residency_check.go - rbac/policy/residency_check_test.go - rbac/audit/events_kms.go - rbac/audit/events_kms_test.go - installer/private/kms_residency_check.sh - docs/security/kms-residency-rollout.md - config/defaults.yaml - infra/kms_policy_fixture.json

Review conversation (highlights): - Alex Wu (reviewer): "Can we ensure the residency check is performed for cached policies? I saw a failing integration where cache misses allowed a bind to proceed." - Priya (author): "Good catch - added explicit cache invalidation on policy change and updated tests to simulate the cache scenario (see commit 4c8d9f0)." - Martina Rossi: "Audit events look fine, but can we avoid embedding full key identifiers in logs? Masking applied?" - Priya: "Events now include key_id_suffix (last 8 chars) and key_id_masked flag. Full keymetadata is available only to authorized auditors via internal API. Added unit test for masking behavior." - Diego Alvarez: "Installer script exits non-zero on drift; needs clearer error message for operators." - Priya: "Updated messages and added link to remediation steps in docs. Also added a --preview flag to the installer to run checks without failing the run."

CI: All checks passed on latest run. - unit tests: pass (coverage: +0.6%) - integration tests: pass (RBAC CI matrix) - linters: pass - security-scan: pass (no new alerts beyond expected config flags)

Backward compatibility and rollout plan: This change ships in audit-only mode by default. We will enable enforcement for a small set of internal orgs for 2 weeks to validate, then gradually flip enforcement using the feature flag. Docs updated with rollback and mitigation steps. No breaking public API changes.

Merge: Squash-merged after approvals from Alex and Martina and green CI. Sha: consolidated into single squashed commit.

Related: Linear ENG-4821 for scheduler follow-ups, SEC-297 for audit requirements.
